numeric_check.method: Numeric similarity-transform registration of unchanged downloaded images; no transformed image saved and no source pixels edited. Foreground grayscale samples from cropped R34 source, bilinear target sampling, normalized luminance correlation optimized with deterministic samples.
numeric_check.limitation: This supports identification of a shared source render in its visible region; it does not certify native game assets or undocumented rear geometry. Target extra club tip remains evaluated visually.

same_render_correspondence.interpretation: Uniform scale plus a small in-plane rotation aligns the already-known rendered surface at high correlation across head, torso, legs and club. This supports a shared pre-existing source render, rather than merely a similar character design. It does not identify an extracted game mesh or verify hidden surfaces.

anatomy_and_asymmetry.club: Preserve the asymmetric skull cluster, diagonal wooden handle, rope bindings and uneven long spikes. All tips must fit within the output; no extrapolation beyond this recovered source is needed.
